findings.title: Static surface comparison supplies raw endpoint range to a quantized classifier
findings.evidence: compareSurfaceFrames copies range_image float directly, whereas physical_evidence_store.cpp:293-295 encodes it with measurement::encodeRange and Snapshot::project:193-194 decodes millimetres. The common classifier uses half a millimetre as the different-ID foreground margin.
findings.normal_input_counterexample: Valid raw endpoint 1.0006 m, query 1.0012 m, different ID/background, tau=0.05 m: raw residual -0.0006 m produces O/unknown, required rounded endpoint 1.001 m gives -0.0002 m and X_L contradiction. All coordinates and depths lie in the normal sensor domain.
findings.consequence: Static source grouping and the suffix predictive n/k/U observations disagree with the documented common endpoint protocol; static extraction can retain frames that required evidence treats as replacement.
findings.required_fix: Quantize/dequantize the endpoint inside the project static adapter, preserving the native input range image; add a real selection-path quantization-boundary regression.
findings.closure: B08-01 closed: shared encodeRange with sensor bounds followed by exactly the PhysicalEvidenceStore float /1000.f decode; invalid code stays invalid; native input unchanged.

findings.title: Undocumented 10cm query clipping suppresses valid forward sphere evidence
findings.evidence: The candidate voting loop continues when camera_point.z() <= 0.1; Projector applies the same hard clip. Equation 12a defines full forward ray/sphere intersections and README explicitly includes spheres crossing the camera plane. Sensor min_range is an endpoint validity restriction, not a historical-query near plane.
findings.normal_input_counterexample: Historical background triangle with centroid camera x=(0,0,0.08)m, h=0.01m, sigma=0, prior p=1. Current camera W=640,H=480,fx=fy=500,cx=320,cy=240,min_range=0.1m sees valid background at 0.5m across the full sphere footprint. The sphere projection (about 63px radius) is fully in bounds and all endpoints exceed far intersection <=0.09m, with no free-limit obstruction. Equations 12a/12 give F=1, so 14 removes it since 1>1 is false. Code skips the frame, keeps F=0 and retains the ghost. The old triangle may have been acquired at 1m from an earlier pose.
findings.consequence: Near-camera historical geometry is incorrectly retained, and near-query identity support is excluded by the projector despite valid forward geometry.
findings.required_fix: Let the documented forward sphere footprint decide observation coverage; retain only the strictly positive-centre requirement for centre projection where division by Z is needed. Add full session refusion near-camera and camera-plane-crossing regressions.
findings.closure: B08-02 closed: positive finite centre Z and bounded floating pixel checks replace hard 0.1m clipping; candidate skip only for a ball wholly behind the camera. Existing in-image forward intersections can still supply support for camera-plane-crossing balls, with absence conservative for unbounded outside coverage.
